name: Oficina Mecânica · Plataforma
description: Saúde técnica da plataforma: latência e throughput da API, saturação do cluster EKS, comportamento do HPA e desempenho das Lambdas de autenticação. Substitua 0 em accountIds pelo ID da sua conta New Relic e ajuste env/appName nas cláusulas WHERE.

pages.name: API
pages.description: Latência, throughput e erros da aplicação PHP. As sondas /api/health e /api/ready ficam de fora: são ~99% das requisições e mascaram a latência real.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'req/min' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-prod' AND request.uri NOT IN ('/api/health', '/api/ready') SINCE 30 minutes ago COMPARE WITH 1 day ago
SELECT percentile(duration * 1000, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-prod' AND request.uri NOT IN ('/api/health', '/api/ready') SINCE 30 minutes ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Erro %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-prod' AND request.uri NOT IN ('/api/health', '/api/ready') SINCE 30 minutes ago
SELECT apdex(duration, t: 0.5) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-prod' AND request.uri NOT IN ('/api/health', '/api/ready') SINCE 30 minutes ago
SELECT percentile(duration * 1000, 50, 95, 99) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-prod' AND request.uri NOT IN ('/api/health', '/api/ready') SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-prod' AND request.uri NOT IN ('/api/health', '/api/ready') FACET name SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Latência p50 / p95 / p99 por rota (ms)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Requisições', percentile(duration * 1000, 50) AS 'p50 (ms)', percentile(duration * 1000, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)', percentile(duration * 1000, 99) AS 'p99 (ms)', percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Erro %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-prod' AND request.uri NOT IN ('/api/health', '/api/ready') FACET name SINCE 3 hours ago LIMIT 30
SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-prod' AND request.uri NOT IN ('/api/health', '/api/ready') AND http.statusCode >= 400 FACET http.statusCode SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

SELECT timestamp, message, correlation_id, method, path, status, exception_class, exception_message FROM Log WHERE service = 'oficina-api' AND env = 'prod' AND level = 'error' SINCE 3 hours ago LIMIT 100

pages.name: Cluster e HPA
pages.description: Saturação dos Pods e dos nodes, e comportamento do autoescalonamento.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(podsAvailable) AS 'Disponíveis', latest(podsDesired) AS 'Desejados' FROM K8sDeploymentSample WHERE deploymentName = 'oficina-api' AND namespaceName = 'oficina-prod' SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

widgets.title: HPA — réplicas atuais x mínimo x máximo

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(currentReplicas) AS 'Atuais', latest(desiredReplicas) AS 'Desejadas', latest(minReplicas) AS 'Mínimo', latest(maxReplicas) AS 'Máximo' FROM K8sHpaSample WHERE displayName = 'oficina-api' AND namespaceName = 'oficina-prod' SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

SELECT average(cpuUsedCores / cpuRequestedCores) * 100 AS 'CPU % do request' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE containerName = 'php-fpm' AND namespaceName = 'oficina-prod' FACET podName SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

SELECT average(memoryWorkingSetBytes / memoryRequestedBytes) * 100 AS 'Memória % do request' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE containerName = 'php-fpm' AND namespaceName = 'oficina-prod' FACET podName SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES
SELECT sum(restartCountDelta) AS 'Reinícios' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE namespaceName = 'oficina-prod' SINCE 3 hours ago
SELECT latest(status), latest(reason), latest(nodeName) FROM K8sPodSample WHERE namespaceName = 'oficina-prod' AND status NOT IN ('Running', 'Succeeded') FACET podName SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: Saturação dos nodes (CPU e memória alocadas)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(allocatableCpuCoresUtilization) AS 'CPU alocada %', average(allocatableMemoryUtilization) AS 'Memória alocada %' FROM K8sNodeSample WHERE clusterName LIKE 'oficina-prod%' SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

pages.name: Lambdas e gateway
pages.description: Invocações, duração, cold start e erros das Lambdas, e tráfego no API Gateway. Fonte: logs do CloudWatch entregues ao New Relic por Kinesis Firehose (oficina-lambda-auth).

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE logGroup IN ('/aws/lambda/oficina-prod-auth-cpf', '/aws/lambda/oficina-prod-jwt-authorizer') AND message LIKE 'REPORT RequestId%' FACET logGroup SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

widgets.title: Duração p50 / p95 / p99 por função (ms)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Invocações', percentile(numeric(aparse(message, 'REPORT RequestId: %Duration: * ms%Billed Duration%')), 50) AS 'p50 (ms)', percentile(numeric(aparse(message, 'REPORT RequestId: %Duration: * ms%Billed Duration%')), 95) AS 'p95 (ms)', percentile(numeric(aparse(message, 'REPORT RequestId: %Duration: * ms%Billed Duration%')), 99) AS 'p99 (ms)' FROM Log WHERE logGroup IN ('/aws/lambda/oficina-prod-auth-cpf', '/aws/lambda/oficina-prod-jwt-authorizer') AND message LIKE 'REPORT RequestId%' FACET logGroup SINCE 3 hours ago

SELECT count(*) AS 'Cold starts' FROM Log WHERE logGroup IN ('/aws/lambda/oficina-prod-auth-cpf', '/aws/lambda/oficina-prod-jwt-authorizer') AND message LIKE 'REPORT RequestId%' AND message LIKE '%Init Duration%' FACET logGroup SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE message LIKE '%Init Duration%') AS 'Cold start %', average(numeric(aparse(message, '%Init Duration: * ms%'))) AS 'Init médio (ms)', max(numeric(aparse(message, '%Init Duration: * ms%'))) AS 'Init máximo (ms)' FROM Log WHERE logGroup IN ('/aws/lambda/oficina-prod-auth-cpf', '/aws/lambda/oficina-prod-jwt-authorizer') AND message LIKE 'REPORT RequestId%' FACET logGroup SINCE 1 day ago

SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE (level = 'error' OR message LIKE '%Task timed out%' OR message LIKE '%Runtime exited%' OR message LIKE '%Runtime.ExitError%')) * 100 / filter(count(*), WHERE message LIKE 'REPORT RequestId%') AS 'Erro %' FROM Log WHERE logGroup = '/aws/lambda/oficina-prod-auth-cpf' SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

widgets.title: API Gateway — requisições por status (access log)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE logGroup = '/aws/apigateway/oficina-prod-api/access' FACET status SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE logGroup = '/aws/apigateway/oficina-prod-api/access' AND status IN ('401', '403') FACET route SINCE 1 day ago
